timing: Retrospective replay: archived source results were inspected before this plan. The corrected-cell arm and shared null were fixed before their outputs were calculated; neither is an independent prospective discovery test.

source_grid.targets: 55 rune-bearing LP2-00–55 pages, excluding runeless LP2-50, plus their concatenation; block origin zero on each target, discard final incomplete block
source_grid.field: GP29 indices modulo 29; matrix left-multiplies consecutive column-vector blocks
source_grid.score: Pinned source log10 English-quadgram mean on concatenated GP transliteration; its declared flag is score > -5.0
source_grid.selection: Maximum over all 24 matrix-operation pairs and 56 targets; retain complete per-pair and per-target scores

corrected_input_arm: Replace only M3_4x4 row4 col4 source value 820 with LP2-15 image/site value 1820. Recalculate M, MT, Minv, MTinv on the same 56 targets. Do not silently alter M3_phi, whose source derivation is not specified.
controls: Verify source 55-page rune arrays match site LP2-00–55 after skipping LP2-50.
Independently verify literal source matrices, mod29 inverses, transpose identities, and all matrix products on small deterministic vectors.

For every invertible operation, encode the known LP2-56 GP reading with its inverse, decode the entire completed blocks and demand exact recovery plus source-score passage; include first and final block checks.

Preserve one common seeded shuffle of each of the 55 source pages per trial; repeat the complete 24-arm/56-target selection for 199 trials with seed 3301. This is a conditional order null, not a cipher model. Reuse each trial's shuffled pages for every arm and for the corrected-cell sensitivity.
exclusions: Other block origins, matrix construction hypotheses, affine offsets, nonlinear ciphers, alternate plaintext languages, missing-rune hypotheses and visual interpretations. The source 4x4 array is not accepted as a verified magic square; the one-cell correction is a bounded input audit.
